subtitle_en: Twenty-one verses in praise of Durga
description_ne: पर्वतपुत्री तथा महिषासुरमर्दिनी दुर्गाको आवाहक स्तोत्र — प्रत्येक श्लोकको अर्थसहित।
description_en: A hymn invoking Durga, daughter of the mountain, as the destroyer of the demon Mahishasura — twenty-one verses, each with its meaning.
source_en: Devotional hymn tradition, traditionally attributed to Adi Shankaracharya

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि गिरिनन्दिनि नन्दितमेदिनि विश्वविनोदिनि नन्दिनुते गिरिवरविन्ध्यशिरोऽधिनिवासिनि विष्णुविलासिनि जिष्णुनुते । भगवति हे शितिकण्ठकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकुटुम्बिनि भूरिकृते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi girinandini nanditamedini viśvavinodini nandinute girivaravindhyaśiro'dhinivāsini viṣṇuvilāsini jiṣṇunute | bhagavati he śitikaṇṭhakuṭumbini bhūrikuṭumbini bhūrikṛte jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 1 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे दिव्य माता, पर्वतकी पुत्री, जसको उपस्थितिले सारा संसार आनन्दले भरिन्छ, जसका लागि संसार नै दिव्य लीला हो, र जसको नन्दीले स्तुति गर्छ — तपाईंलाई नमस्कार। विन्ध्य पर्वतको शिखरमा बस्ने, विष्णुलाई बहिनीका रूपमा आनन्द दिने, र इन्द्रले प्रशंसा गर्ने देवी। हे भगवती, नीलकण्ठ शिवकी पत्नी, अनगिन्ती सम्बन्धकी ब्रह्माण्डमाता, सृष्टिमा समृद्धि रचना गर्ने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Salutations to the Divine Mother, daughter of the mountain, by whose presence the whole world is filled with joy, for whom the world is a divine play, and who is praised by Nandi. She dwells on the summit of the Vindhyas, the best of mountains, gives joy to Vishnu as his sister, and is praised by Indra. O Bhagavati, consort of blue-throated Shiva, cosmic mother of countless relations, who has created abundance. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुरवरवर्षिणि दुर्धरधर्षिणि दुर्मुखमर्षिणि हर्षरते त्रिभुवनपोषिणि शङ्करतोषिणि किल्बिषमोषिणि घोषरते दनुजनिरोषिणि दितिसुतरोषिणि दुर्मदशोषिणि सिन्धुसुते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ २ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: suravaravarṣiṇi durdharadharṣiṇi durmukhamarṣiṇi harṣarate tribhuvanapoṣiṇi śaṅkaratoṣiṇi kilbiṣamoṣiṇi ghoṣarate danujaniroṣiṇi ditisutaroṣiṇi durmadaśoṣiṇi sindhusute jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 2 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: देवताहरूमा वर वर्षाउने, दुर्धर दानवलाई पराजित गर्ने, दुर्मुखलाई सहेर अन्त्यमा वध गर्ने, र आफ्नै आनन्दमा रमाउने। तीन लोकलाई पोषण गर्ने, शङ्करलाई सन्तुष्ट पार्ने, र युद्धको कोलाहलमा पाप हरण गर्ने। दनुजहरूको क्रोध शान्त पार्ने, दैत्यहरूप्रति रोष राख्ने, दानवहरूको मूर्ख अहङ्कार सुकाउने, र लक्ष्मीका रूपमा सागरपुत्री। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who showers boons on the devas, who overpowered the unrestrainable demon Durdhara, endured and finally slew the foul-mouthed Durmukha, and who delights in her own bliss. Who sustains the three worlds, delights Shankara, and removes sins amid the tumult of battle. Who quells the wrath of the Danavas, is angry with the Daityas, dries up the foolish pride of demons, and who, as Lakshmi, is the daughter of the ocean. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि जगदम्ब मदम्ब कदम्ब वनप्रियवासिनि हासरते शिखरि शिरोमणि तुङ्गहिमालय शृङ्गनिजालय मध्यगते । मधुमधुरे मधुकैटभगञ्जिनि कैटभभञ्जिनि रासरते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ३ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi jagadamba madamba kadamba vanapriyavāsini hāsarate śikhari śiromaṇi tuṅgahimālaya śṛṅganijālaya madhyagate | madhumadhure madhukaiṭabhagañjini kaiṭabhabhañjini rāsarate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 3 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जगत्की आमा र मेरी आफ्नै आमा, कदम्ब वनमा बस्न रुचाउने र हाँसोमा रमाउने। अग्लो हिमालयको शिरोमणि शिखरको बीचमा वास गर्ने। महजस्तै मधुर, मधु र कैटभको अहङ्कार दमन गरी त्यो महायुद्धको कोलाहलमा उनीहरूलाई नष्ट गर्ने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Mother of the universe and my own mother, who loves to dwell in the Kadamba forest and delights in laughter. Who abides in the midst of the crest-jewel peaks of the lofty Himalaya. Sweet as honey, who subdued the pride of Madhu and Kaitabha and destroyed them amid the uproar of that great battle. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि शतखण्ड विखण्डितरुण्ड वितुण्डितशुण्ड गजाधिपते रिपुगजगण्ड विदारणचण्ड पराक्रमशुण्ड मृगाधिपते । निजभुजदण्ड निपातितखण्ड विपातितमुण्ड भटाधिपते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ४ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi śatakhaṇḍa vikhaṇḍitaruṇḍa vituṇḍitaśuṇḍa gajādhipate ripugajagaṇḍa vidāraṇacaṇḍa parākramaśuṇḍa mṛgādhipate | nijabhujadaṇḍa nipātitakhaṇḍa vipātitamuṇḍa bhaṭādhipate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 4 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शत्रुका हात्तीहरूकी विजेता, जसले तिनीहरूका सुँड र शिर, अनि शिरविहीन धडलाई सय टुक्रा पारिन्। जसको सिंहले शत्रुका शक्तिशाली हात्तीका मुख चिरिदिन्छ। आफ्ना हातका अस्त्रले चण्ड र मुण्डजस्ता दानवका शिर ढालेर शत्रु योद्धाहरूलाई जित्ने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Conqueror of the enemy's elephants, who cut their trunks and heads, and those headless bodies, into a hundred pieces. Whose lion fiercely tears asunder the faces of the powerful elephants of the enemy. Who felled the heads of demons such as Chanda and Munda with the weapons in her arms and conquered the enemy warriors. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि रणदुर्मद शत्रुवधोदित दुर्धरनिर्जर शक्तिभृते चतुरविचार धुरीणमहाशिव दूतकृत प्रमथाधिपते । दुरितदुरीह दुराशयदुर्मति दानवदूत कृतान्तमते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ५ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi raṇadurmad śatruvadhodita durdharanirjara śaktibhṛte caturavicāra dhurīṇamahāśiva dūtakṛta pramathādhipate | duritadurīha durāśayadurmati dānavadūta kṛtāntamate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 5 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: रणमा मत्त, अहङ्कारी दानवहरूको नाशका लागि प्रकट भएकी, र अदम्य, अविनाशी शक्ति धारण गर्ने। विचारमा निपुण, प्रमथहरूका स्वामी महाशिवलाई आफ्नो दूत बनाउने। दुष्ट बुद्धि भएको, अज्ञानी दानव-दूत (शुम्भको दूत) को प्रस्ताव अस्वीकार गरेर ती दानवहरूकै अन्त्य ल्याएकी, त्यसैले सम्मानित। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who manifested to destroy battle-intoxicated, arrogant demons, and who bears unrestrainable, imperishable power. Who made Lord Shiva her messenger — that Shiva distinguished by clever deliberation and lord of the pramathas. Who is honoured for rejecting the proposal of the evil-minded, ignorant messenger of the demon Shumbha, and so bringing those demons to an end. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि शरणागत वैरिवधूवर वीरवराभय दायकरे त्रिभुवनमस्तक शूलविरोधि शिरोऽधिकृतामल शूलकरे । दुमिदुमितामर धुन्दुभिनादमहोमुखरीकृत दिङ्मकरे जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ६ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi śaraṇāgata vairivadhūvara vīravarābhaya dāyakare tribhuvanamastaka śūlavirodhi śiro'dhikṛtāmala śūlakare | dumidumitāmara dhundubhinādamahomukharīkṛta diṅmakare jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 6 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: शत्रुका पत्नीहरूले शरण लिँदा तिनीहरूका वीर योद्धाहरूलाई अभय दिने। जसको विशुद्ध त्रिशूलले त्यो त्रिशूलको विरोध गर्ने त्रिलोकका शासकहरूका शिर समात्छ। जसको विजयले दुन्दुभीको दुमि-दुमि ध्वनि निरन्तर उठेर सबै दिशा आनन्दले मुखरित हुन्छन्। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who gave fearlessness to the heroic soldiers of the enemy when their good wives took refuge in her. Whose pure trident seizes the heads of the rulers of the three worlds who oppose that trident. Whose victory sends up the ceaseless dumi-dumi of the dundubhi drum, filling every direction with joy. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि निजहुङ्कृति मात्रनिराकृत धूम्रविलोचन धूम्रशते समरविशोषित शोणितबीज समुद्भवशोणित बीजलते । शिवशिवशुम्भ निशुम्भमहाहव तर्पितभूत पिशाचरते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ७ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi nijahuṅkṛti mātranirākṛta dhūmravilocana dhūmraśate samaraviśoṣita śoṇitabīja samudbhavaśoṇita bījalate | śivaśivaśumbha niśumbhamahāhava tarpitabhūta piśācarate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 7 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: केवल हुङ्कारले नै धूम्रलोचन दानवलाई सय धुवाँ-कणमा परिणत गर्ने। मूल रक्तबीज र रगतको प्रत्येक थोपाबाट लहराझैं जन्मिने रक्तबीजहरूको बल युद्धमा सुकाउने। शुम्भ र निशुम्भको महाहवनले शिवका भूत-पिशाचहरूलाई तृप्त पार्ने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who reduced the demon Dhumralochana to a hundred particles of smoke with a mere humkara. Who dried up the original Raktabija and the Raktabijas born from him like a creeper from every drop of blood. Whose great sacrifice of Shumbha and Nishumbha satisfied the ghosts and fiends attending Shiva. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: धनुरनुषङ्ग रणक्षणसङ्ग परिस्फुरदङ्ग नटत्कटके कनकपिशङ्ग पृषत्कनिषङ्ग रसद्भटशृङ्ग हताबटुके । कृतचतुरङ्ग बलक्षितिरङ्ग घटद्बहुरङ्ग रटद्बटुके जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ८ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: dhanuranuṣaṅga raṇakṣaṇasaṅga parisphuradaṅga naṭatkaṭake kanakapiśaṅga pṛṣatkaniṣaṅga rasadbhaṭaśṛṅga hatābaṭuke | kṛtacaturaṅga balakṣitiraṅga ghaṭadbahuraṅga raṭadbaṭuke jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 8 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: युद्धको प्रत्येक क्षणमा धनुषको चालसँगै चम्किला बाहुमा कङ्कण नाच्ने। सुनौला बाण शत्रुमा लाग्दा राता भएर, तिनीहरूको व्यर्थ चिच्याहटका बाबजुद उनीहरूलाई मार्ने। चारै अङ्गको शत्रुसेना — अनेक रङका, व्यर्थ अहङ्कारले कराउने अनेक शिर — लाई क्षीण हुँदै जाने खेलमा बदलिदिने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whose bracelet dances on her shining arms with every movement of the bow in each instant of battle. Whose golden arrows grow reddish as they cling to the howling enemies and slay them despite their vain screams. Who turns the enemy's fourfold army — many heads of many colours, howling in empty pride — into a play of failing strength. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: सुरललना ततथेयि तथेयि कृताभिनयोदर नृत्यरते कृत कुकुथः कुकुथो गडदादिकताल कुतूहल गानरते । धुधुकुट धुक्कुट धिंधिमित ध्वनि धीर मृदंग निनादरते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ९ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: suralalanā tatatheyi tatheyi kṛtābhinayodara nṛtyarate kṛta kukuthaḥ kukutho gaḍadādikatāla kutūhala gānarate | dhudhukuṭa dhukkuṭa dhiṃdhimita dhvani dhīra mṛdaṅga ninādarate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 9 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको महायुद्धको तालमा अप्सराहरू त-थ-थेयि, त-थेयि नाचेर युद्धको भाव अभिनय गर्छन्। जसका गायकहरू कुकुथः कुकुथो, गडदादि तालले युद्धको उत्सुकता समेट्छन्। जसको पछि मृदङ्गको स्थिर गहिरो ध्वनि धुधुकुट, धुक्कुट, धिंधिमित बजिरहन्छ। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: To the rhythm of whose great battle the celestial dancers dance ta-tha-theyi, ta-theyi, acting out the feeling of the fight. Whose musicians capture the tense eagerness of battle in talas such as ku-kutha and ga-da-dha. Behind whom a steady mridanga sounds dhu-dhu-kuta, dhu-kuta, dhim-dhimi. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: जय जय जप्य जयेजयशब्द परस्तुति तत्परविश्वनुते झणझणझिञ्झिमि झिङ्कृत नूपुरशिञ्जितमोहित भूतपते । नटित नटार्ध नटी नट नायक नाटितनाट्य सुगानरते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १० ॥
shlokas.transliteration: jaya jaya japya jayejayaśabda parastuti tatparaviśvanute jhaṇajhaṇajhiñjhimi jhiṅkṛta nūpuraśiñjitamohita bhūtapate | naṭita naṭārdha naṭī naṭa nāyaka nāṭitanāṭya sugānarate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 10 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: सारा संसारले स्तुति गर्ने — युद्धअघि जय-जप, युद्धपछि जय-शब्द, अनि स्तुतिगान। झणझण बज्ने नूपुरले भूतपति शिवलाई मोहित पार्ने। शिवको आधा अङ्ग भएर नाच्ने, जहाँ नट र नटी एउटै शरीरका नायक हुन् र दिव्य नादको गीतसँगै विश्वनाट्य चल्छ। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Praised by the whole world: victory muttered before the battle, victory shouted after it, and then her stuti sung. Whose anklets, jingling jhana-jhana, captivate Shiva, lord of the ghosts. Who dances as half the body of Shiva, the hero and heroine of the cosmic play sung with the divine sound. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि सुमनःसुमनःसुमनः सुमनःसुमनोहरकान्तियुते श्रितरजनी रजनीरजनी रजनीरजनी करवक्त्रवृते । सुनयनविभ्रमर भ्रमरभ्रमर भ्रमरभ्रमराधिपते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ ११ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi sumanaḥsumanaḥsumanaḥ sumanaḥsumanoharakāntiyute śritarajanī rajanīrajanī rajanīrajanī karavaktravṛte | sunayanavibhramara bhramarabhramara bhramarabhramarādhipate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 11 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको सुन्दर मन मोहक रूपसँग एक भएको छ। जसको मुखले रातको चन्द्रज्योतिको सौन्दर्यलाई आफ्नै कान्तिले ढाकेर अधीन पार्छ। जसका सुन्दर नेत्रले भ्रमरहरूको सौन्दर्यलाई पनि जित्छन्। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whose beautiful mind is united with a charming appearance. Whose face makes the moonlight of the night give way, hiding that beauty with her own. Whose beautiful eyes conquer the beauty of the bees by their own loveliness. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: सहितमहाहव मल्लमतल्लिक मल्लितरल्लक मल्लरते विरचितवल्लिक पल्लिकमल्लिक झिल्लिकभिल्लिक वर्गवृते । शितकृतफुल्ल समुल्लसितारुण तल्लजपल्लव सल्ललिते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १२ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: sahitamahāhava mallamatallika mallitarallaka mallarate viracitavallika pallikamallika jhillikabhillika vargavṛte | śitakṛtaphulla samullasitāruṇa tallajapallava sallalite jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 12 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: उत्कृष्ट योद्धाहरूविरुद्धको महायुद्धमा मल्लिका (चमेली) जस्तै कोमल देखिने कन्याहरूसँगै रहेकी। साथमा भील कुलका कन्याहरू, मल्लिकाको लहराजस्तै कोमल र भ्रमरझैं गुन्जने। जसको मुस्कान उषाझैं रातो छ र उत्तम फूलका कोपिला फुलाउँछ। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Accompanied in the great battle against excellent fighters by girls who seem tender as jasmine as they fight the enemy. Whose companions are girls of the Bheel tribe, tender as creepers of jasmine and buzzing like swarms of bees. Whose smiling face is like the red dawn, blossoming the finest buds of flowers. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अविरलगण्ड गलन्मदमेदुर मत्तमतङ्गज राजपते त्रिभुवनभूषण भूतकलानिधि रूपपयोनिधि राजसुते । अयि सुदतीजन लालसमानस मोहन मन्मथराजसुते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १३ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: aviralagaṇḍa galanmadamedura mattamataṅgaja rājapate tribhuvanabhūṣaṇa bhūtakalānidhi rūpapayonidhi rājasute | ayi sudatījana lālasamānasa mohana manmatharājasute jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 13 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: राजसी मत्त हात्तीझैं, जसका गालाबाट कला, सौन्दर्य र शक्तिको बाक्लो मद निरन्तर झर्छ। राजाकी पुत्री, जसबाट तीन लोकको भूषण बन्ने कला, रूप र शक्तिका निधि निस्कन्छन्। सुन्दर मुस्कान भएकाहरूप्रति मनमा लालसा र मोह जगाउने मन्मथकी पुत्रीझैं। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Like a royal intoxicated elephant from whose cheeks the thick mada of arts, beauty and power oozes without cease. Daughter of the king, from whom come the treasures of art, beauty and power that ornament the three worlds. Like the daughter of Manmatha, who stirs desire and infatuation for women of a beautiful smile. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: कमलदलामल कोमलकान्ति कलाकलितामल भाललते सकलविलास कलानिलयक्रम केलिचलत्कल हंसकुले । अलिकुलसङ्कुल कुवलयमण्डल मौलिमिलद्बकुलालिकुले जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १४ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: kamaladalāmala komalakānti kalākalitāmala bhālalate sakalavilāsa kalānilayakrama kelicalatkala haṃsakule | alikulasaṅkula kuvalayamaṇḍala maulimiladbakulālikule jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 14 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको निर्मल, चम्किलो निधारमा निष्कलङ्क कमलदलको कोमल कान्ति कलापूर्वक कोरिएको छ। जसको चाल हंसहरूको खेलपूर्ण, मृदु चालजस्तै छ, जसबाट सबै कलाक्रमशः प्रकट हुन्छन्। जसको बाँधिएको केश भ्रमरले भरिएको नीलकमल र बकुल फूलको मिठास एकै ठाउँमा जोड्छ। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: On whose stainless, shining forehead the tender beauty of a spotless lotus petal is drawn with art. Whose movement is like the playful, soft movement of a flock of swans, from which every school of art appears in succession. Whose braided hair joins the blue water-lily crowded with bees and the bakula flower with its own swarm. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: करमुरलीरव वीजितकूजित लज्जितकोकिल मञ्जुमते मिलितपुलिन्द मनोहरगुञ्जित रञ्जितशैल निकुञ्जगते । निजगणभूत महाशबरीगण सद्गुणसम्भृत केलितले जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १५ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: karamuralīrava vījita-kūjita lajjitakokila mañjumate militapulinda manoharaguñjita rañjitaśaila nikuñjagate | nijagaṇabhūta mahāśabarīgaṇa sadguṇasambhṛta kelitale jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 15 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हातको मुरलीको स्वरलाई पनि नीरस तुल्याउने, र आफ्नो स्वरको सुन्दरताले कोइलीलाई लजाउने। पुलिन्द कुलका कन्याहरूसँगै फूलले रङ्गिएका पर्वतीय कुञ्जमा हृदय चुराउने गीत गुन्गुनाउने। आफ्नै समूहका सद्गुणले भरिएका शबरीहरूसँग खेल्ने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who makes the flute in her hand sound wet and monotonous, and puts the cuckoo to shame by the beauty of her voice. Who hums heart-stealing songs with the girls of the Pulinda tribe while walking the flower-bright groves of the mountains. Who plays with the tribal women of her own group, filled with good virtues. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: कटितटपीत दुकूलविचित्र मयूखतिरस्कृत चन्द्ररुचे प्रणतसुरासुर मौलिमणिस्फुरदंशुलसन्नख चन्द्ररुचे जितकनकाचल मौलिमदोर्जित निर्भरकुञ्जर कुम्भकुचे जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १६ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: kaṭitaṭapīta dukūlavicitra mayūkhatiraskṛta candraruce praṇatasurāsura maulimaṇisphuradaṃśulasannakha candraruce jitakanakācala maulimadorjita nirbharakuñjara kumbhakuce jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 16 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: कम्मरमा अनेक रङको रेशमी वस्त्र, जसको चमकले चन्द्रमाको उज्यालोलाई पनि पार गर्छ। नतमस्तक सुर र असुरका मुकुटका मणिले झल्किने नङमा चन्द्रझैं कान्ति फैलिन्छ। सुनौलो पर्वतझैं अहङ्कारले फुलेका शिरलाई आफ्नो घटजस्तो वक्षको शक्ति र करुणाले जित्ने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whose waist is wrapped in silk of many colours, the lustre of which eclipses the brightness of the moon. On whose toe-nails, throbbing with the radiance of the gems in the diadems of devas and asuras who bow there, a moonlike brightness spreads. Who wins over heads swollen with pride like a golden mountain, by the power and compassion abounding in her pitcher-like bosom. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: विजितसहस्रकरैक सहस्रकरैक सहस्रकरैकनुते कृतसुरतारक सङ्गरतारक सङ्गरतारक सूनुसुते । सुरथसमाधि समानसमाधि समाधिसमाधि सुजातरते । जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १७ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: vijitasahasrakaraika sahasrakaraika sahasrakaraikanute kṛtasuratāraka saṅgaratāraka saṅgaratāraka sūnusute | surathasamādhi samānasamādhi samādhisamādhi sujātarate | jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 17 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हजार हातले लड्ने हजार शत्रुलाई आफ्ना हजार हात प्रकट गरेर जित्ने, अनि भक्तहरूका हजार हातले आफ्नो स्तुति गराउने। देवताहरूका रक्षक पुत्र कार्तिकेयलाई तारकासुरसँगको युद्धका लागि सिर्जना गरी त्यो महायुद्धमा पठाउने। लौकिक फलका लागि राजा सुरथको भक्ति-चिन्तन र ज्ञानका लागि व्यापारी समाधिको उत्तम चिन्तन दुवैले प्रसन्न हुने। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Who conquers thousands of enemies fighting her with thousands of hands by manifesting her own thousand hands, and then makes thousands of devotees' hands praise her. Who created Kartikeya, rescuer of the devas, to fight the demon Tarakasura, and urged her son into that great fight. Who is pleased alike with King Suratha's contemplation for worldly gain and with the merchant Samadhi's contemplation for spiritual knowledge. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: पदकमलं करुणानिलये वरिवस्यति योऽनुदिनं सुशिवे अयि कमले कमलानिलये कमलानिलयः स कथं न भवेत् । तव पदमेव परम्पदमित्यनुशीलयतो मम किं न शिवे जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १८ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: padakamalaṃ karuṇānilaye varivasyati yo'nudinaṃ suśive ayi kamale kamalānilaye kamalānilayaḥ sa kathaṃ na bhavet | tava padameva parampadamityanuśīlayato mama kiṃ na śive jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 18 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जो व्यक्ति करुणाको निवास, अति मङ्गलमय तपाईंका पादकमलको हरेक दिन सेवा गर्छ — त्यो कमल नै कमला (महालक्ष्मी) को निवास हो — के ऊ स्वयं कमलाको निवास, पवित्रता र समृद्धिले भरिएको, बन्दैन र? तपाईंका चरण नै परम शरण हुन्; त्यसैले हे शुभे, म तिनको भक्ति किन अभ्यास नगरूँ? जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whoever serves every day your highly auspicious lotus feet, an abode of compassion — that lotus which is itself the abode of Kamala, Mahalakshmi — will he not himself become an abode of Kamala, filled with purity and prosperity? Your feet are indeed the supreme refuge; how, then, can I not practise devotion to them, O auspicious mother? Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: कनकलसत्कलसिन्धुजलैरनुषिञ्चति तेगुणरङ्गभुवम् भजति स किं न शचीकुचकुम्भतटीपरिरम्भसुखानुभवम् । तव चरणं शरणं करवाणि नतामरवाणि निवासि शिवम् जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ १९ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: kanakalasatkalasindhujalairanuṣiñcati teguṇaraṅgabhuvam bhajati sa kiṃ na śacīkucakumbhataṭīparirambhasukhānubhavam | tava caraṇaṃ śaraṇaṃ karavāṇi natāmaravāṇi nivāsi śivam jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 19 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जब भक्तले सुनझैं चम्किने, मन्द बग्ने नदीको जलले तपाईंका गुण प्रकट हुने स्थान सिञ्चन गर्छ, के उसले तपाईंको घटजस्तो वक्षमा रहेको सर्वव्यापी कृपाको सुख अनुभव गर्दैन र? त्यसैले हे वाणि, म तपाईंका चरण शरण बनाउँछु, र सबै मङ्गल बस्ने सनातन सरस्वतीलाई प्रणाम गर्छु। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: When a devotee washes the place where your attributes are shown with softly flowing river water shining like gold, will he not feel the joy of your all-embracing grace held in your pitcher-like bosom? Therefore I take refuge at your feet, O Vani, and I bow to you, eternal Saraswati, in whom all auspiciousness resides. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: तव विमलेन्दुकुलं वदनेन्दुमलं सकलं ननु कूलयते किमु पुरुहूतपुरीन्दु मुखी सुमुखीभिरसौ विमुखीक्रियते । मम तु मतं शिवनामधने भवती कृपया किमुत क्रियते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ २० ॥
shlokas.transliteration: tava vimalendukulaṃ vadanendumalaṃ sakalaṃ nanu kūlayate kimu puruhūtapurīndu mukhī sumukhībhirasau vimukhīkriyate | mama tu mataṃ śivanāmadhane bhavatī kṛpayā kimuta kriyate jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 20 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: जसको चन्द्रझैं मुख निर्मल शुद्धिको निवास हो र निश्चय नै सबै मलिनतालाई दमन गर्छ। नत्र मेरो मन इन्द्रपुरीका चन्द्रमुखी सुन्दरीहरूबाट किन फर्कियो? मेरो मतमा, तपाईंको कृपाबिना हामीभित्र शिवनामको धन कसरी भेटिन्छ? जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: Whose moon-like face is an abode of spotless purity that certainly subdues every impurity. Otherwise, why has my mind turned away from the moon-faced beauties of Indra's court? In my view, without your grace, how can the treasure of Shiva's name be discovered within us? Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.

shlokas.sanskrit: अयि मयि दीन दयालुतया कृपयैव त्वया भवितव्यमुमे अयि जगतो जननी कृपयासि यथासि तथानुमितासिरते । यदुचितमत्र भवत्युररीकुरुतादुरुतापमपाकुरुते जय जय हे महिषासुरमर्दिनि रम्यकपर्दिनि शैलसुते ॥ २१ ॥
shlokas.transliteration: ayi mayi dīna dayālutayā kṛpayaiva tvayā bhavitavyam ume ayi jagato jananī kṛpayāsi yathāsi tathānumitāsirate | yaducitamatra bhavatyurarīkurutādurutāpamapākurute jaya jaya he mahiṣāsuramardini ramyakapardini śailasute || 21 ||
shlokas.meaning_ne: हे उमे, दीनमा दयालु तपाईंले ममाथि अवश्य कृपा गर्नुपर्छ। हे जगत्की जननी, जसरी भक्तमाथि कृपा वर्षिन्छ, त्यसरी नै शत्रुमाथि बाण छरिन्छ र तिनीहरूको अहङ्कार नष्ट हुन्छ। हे पूजनीय माता, अहिले जे उचित छ त्यही गर्नुहोस्, र बोक्न गाह्रो भएको यो ताप हटाउनुहोस्। जय होस्, जय होस्, हे महिषासुरकी मर्दिनी, सुन्दर कपर्दले शोभित पर्वतपुत्री।
shlokas.meaning_en: You must bestow your grace on me, O Uma, who are compassionate to the miserable. O mother of the universe, just as your grace is showered on devotees, so are your arrows scattered on enemies, destroying their egos. Please do whatever is fitting now, O worshipful mother, to remove the sorrows that have become too heavy to bear. Victory, victory to you, destroyer of the demon Mahishasura, shining with beautiful locks of hair, daughter of the mountain.
